items.caption:
NHSMUN 2027 IS OUT! 🗽

The National High School Model United Nations Conference will be held from March 12 to March 15 (during spring break) in New York City. Registration, hotel, and transportation fees will add up to be around $1,300-2,000 (subject to change) and are not refundable. For more information, visit imuna.org.

This is a wonderful opportunity to experience a (perhaps the most) prestigious MUN conference, explore NYC, visit the UN headquarters, and meet international MUNners! We encourage applications from all levels of MUN experience, but, as we have a limited number of spots, we will be prioritizing upperclassmen/returning members.

Apply to attend at tinyurl.com/nhsmun2026. This binding application form is due at 11:59 p.m. on October 20. Please carefully read all information on the form before submitting.
